name: GPS (Global Positioning System)
tagline: The original GNSS — 31 satellites, free public service since 2000
description: Global Positioning System — the original GNSS and still the most widely used. 31 active satellites at 20,180 km in 6 orbital planes inclined 55°. Operated by US Space Force; originally Department of Defense with civilian unencrypted L1 C/A signal opened in 1983 after Korean Air Lines 007 was shot down. Civilian accuracy improved dramatically when Selective Availability was turned off in 2000. Modernised L1C, L2C, L5 signals on Block IIF and III satellites.
best_known_for: The original GNSS — 31 satellites, free public service since 2000
